parrafo_1.es: Wayne Heads Southern Kitchen | Soul es un food truck junto a una gasolinera sobre NE Waldo Rd en Gainesville. El ambiente es sencillo, pero la sazón es real: alitas, pescado, chuleta de cerdo y camarones fritos al momento, con terraza cubierta para hasta 10 personas.
parrafo_1.en: Wayne Heads Southern Kitchen | Soul is a food truck next to a gas station on NE Waldo Rd in Gainesville. The setting is simple, but the seasoning is real: wings, fish, pork chop and shrimp fried to order, with a covered deck that seats up to 10.

parrafo_2.es: 250 reseñas en Google con 4.8 de calificación lo confirman: todo se cocina al momento, así que a veces hay que esperar, pero los clientes dicen que vale la pena cada minuto.
parrafo_2.en: 250 reviews on Google at a 4.8 rating confirm it: everything is cooked to order, so there can be a wait, but customers say every minute is worth it.

texto.es: Estamos en 1602 NE Waldo Rd, junto a la gasolinera. Abiertos de lunes a viernes.
texto.en: We are at 1602 NE Waldo Rd, right next to the gas station. Open Monday through Friday.

texto.es: Elige del menú: alitas, chicken sandwich, pescado, chuleta de cerdo, camarones o las ensaladas de la casa.
texto.en: Pick from the menu: wings, chicken sandwich, fish, pork chop, shrimp or the house salads.

texto.es: Todo se cocina cuando lo pides, con sazón de verdad. Puede haber espera, pero vale la pena.
texto.en: Everything is cooked when you order it, with real seasoning. There can be a short wait, but it is worth it.

texto.es: Come en la terraza cubierta o llévalo contigo. Cualquiera de las dos, con amor y soul.
texto.en: Eat on the covered deck or take it with you. Either way, with love and soul.

nota.es: Precios del menú vigente en el camión; pueden variar sin previo aviso.
nota.en: Prices from the truck's posted menu; subject to change without notice.

texto.es: Con salsa Golden Flavor o Sweet and Hot. Las reseñas las describen como las mejores alitas que han probado.
texto.en: Tossed in Golden Flavor or Sweet and Hot sauce. Reviewers call them some of the best wings they have ever had.

texto.es: Pollo frito crujiente en pan brioche, con salsa dorada. También disponible en combo con papas.
texto.en: Crispy fried chicken on a brioche bun with golden sauce. Also available as a combo with fries.

texto.es: Camarones fritos o a la plancha, con la opción Surf & Turf junto al pescado.
texto.en: Fried or grilled shrimp, with a Surf & Turf option paired with the fish.

texto.es: El plato insignia de la casa, la combinación más grande del menú.
texto.en: The house's signature plate, the biggest combination on the menu.

pie.es: También hay pescado, chuleta de cerdo, cheeseburger y ensaladas de pollo o jamón. Pregunta en el camión.
pie.en: There is also fish, pork chop, cheeseburger and chicken or ham salads. Ask right at the truck.

items.quote: Crispy, saucy, and delicious! I’ve been so used to eating wings that are bland and almost soggy, but these wings had the perfect crisp texture and the sauce was so flavorful. Definitely some of the best wings my husband and I have ever had. Check this place out!

Let me tell you something. This food is amazing! It's a trailer next to a gas station so the atmosphere is terrible and you may have to wait for service but it's worth it. They actually use seasoning. The shrimp was incredible. The slider burgers have golden sauce and red bell peppers. The wings I got with Sweet and Hot but his specialty is the Golden Flavor. Love and soul has been added to this food.

I ordered the chicken sandwich with fries and the meal was made to order, fresh and hot. Very good flavor and portion size was good for the price. Be prepared to wait because all orders are made fresh but it's worth the wait.

This is an amazing roadside kitchen in a gas station lot. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. We had wings, fried shrimp and FF. The wings has an amazing crunch to them and the Cajun ranch sauce had the right amount of heat without burning your face off.

texto.es: Llama antes de pasar; el camión abre de lunes a viernes.
texto.en: Call before you come by; the truck is open Monday through Friday.
